Thought: I need to search the knowledge base.
Action: search_knowledge_base
Action Input: What is the computational security status of the AES-256 encryption standard against brute-force attacks?

final_answer: The AES-256 encryption standard is highly resistant to brute-force attacks due to its large key size and complexity. It would take billions of years with current technology to crack it using brute force. (Sources: Knowledge Base)
